audience: Wei Ling and Daniel, Malaysian citizens living in Perth on subclass 491 visas, comparing a first three-bedroom house before or after actual permanent-visa grants; useful to similarly situated temporary-resident couples without transferring their eligibility.
localeReason: English and Simplified Chinese: this WA upfront-cash and actual-PR-timing comparison is genuinely useful to Chinese-speaking Malaysian and other 491-holder couples. Translation does not assign ethnicity, language preference or new nationality to Wei Ling and Daniel, change their profile, or transfer their eligibility. This director-approved continuation supersedes the initial English-only authoring decision.

pr_reserve_target.status: $163,350 plus $20,000 illustrative reserve; no projected savings assumed

profile.visaOutcome: Not individually verified; eligibility is not grant

baseline.prPurchase: Eligible established first home only after both actual grants; 2028 hypothetical
baseline.rules: Freeze current rules/fees for comparison, not future certainty

otherAllowances.status: All unconfirmed allowances, not quotes; registration is not published Landgate fee

highLvr.status: Not premium quotes or approval; LMI protects lender

otp.status: Qualifying property/contract/federal classification and actual finance required; net funding not staged liquidity; actual LPF unknown, no double-counted LMI

growthSensitivity.status: No forecast or total-wealth break-even; rent, interest, ongoing costs, savings returns and market risk excluded

repayments.status: Sensitivities not offers or visa premiums; ongoing bills excluded; assessment rate may be higher

savings.status: No monthly surplus inferred from gross income; no returns, interest or inflation

planningAssumptions.exclusions: No reserve in acquisition tables, no future loan approval, price/valuation divergence, construction/rent/progress-interest overruns, renovations/furnishing or ongoing ownership bills. No government low-deposit guarantee, professional LMI waiver, future promotion or speculative benefit/refund counted. Contract deposit is part of equity; new-home price includes applicable GST, no extra GST added.
